headline: Ottawa Begins Rolling Out $700 Million in AI Compute Funding
summary: The Canadian government has begun rolling out $700 million in AI compute funding, providing 45 companies with $52 million in cloud subsidies.
why: State-backed high-performance computing investments aim to accelerate artificial intelligence commercialization and domestic technology adoption.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Government subsidies provide direct financial support to domestic technology and AI startups.
